# xdp.es DNS

> Public, zero-logging recursive DNS resolver with DNSSEC, DoH, DoT, and built-in malware and ad blocking.

## Endpoints

- [Standard DNS over HTTPS (DoH)](https://dns.xdp.es/dns-query): RFC 8484 endpoint supporting HTTP/2 and HTTP/3 QUIC with GET and POST wireformat queries.
- [Block-OTA DNS over HTTPS (DoH)](https://dns.xdp.es/block-ota/dns-query): Specialized DoH resolver blocking ads, Apple OTA update servers, and OCSP endpoints.
- [Live Metrics API](https://xdp.es/stats.json): Real-time anonymized telemetry and resolution statistics in JSON format.
- [OpenAPI 3.1 Specification](https://xdp.es/openapi.json): Machine-readable schema for agent function-calling and tool use.
- [Comprehensive Agent Documentation](https://xdp.es/llms-full.txt): In-depth system architecture, parameters, and OS configuration scripts.
- [Interactive Telemetry Dashboard](https://xdp.es/stats): Web-based visual metrics dashboard with 24h and 30d views.
- [Apple OTA Blocker Page](https://xdp.es/block-ota): Documentation and mobileconfig profiles to prevent iOS/macOS automatic updates.

## Configuration Profiles

- [Apple DoH Standard Profile](https://xdp.es/dns_xdp_es_doh.mobileconfig): Automatic DNS over HTTPS configuration for iOS, iPadOS, and macOS.
- [Apple DoT Standard Profile](https://xdp.es/dns_xdp_es_dot.mobileconfig): Automatic DNS over TLS configuration for iOS, iPadOS, and macOS.
- [Apple Block-OTA DoH Profile](https://xdp.es/dns_xdp_es_block_ota_doh.mobileconfig): DNS over HTTPS configuration blocking iOS/macOS system updates and OCSP checks.

## IP Addresses

- [IPv4 DNS Resolver](https://xdp.es/): Standard recursive DNS on 85.208.114.51 (Port 53 UDP/TCP).
- [IPv6 DNS Resolver](https://xdp.es/): Standard recursive DNS on 2a0e:97c0:c40::51 (Port 53 UDP/TCP).
